description: As an analyst I can filter the timeline to specific event IDs so I only see logon or process events without unrelated noise
steps: wt-evtx timeline -d <dir> --eid 4624,4625 outputs only events with those IDs
wt-evtx timeline -d <dir> --eid 4688 outputs only process creation events
passing an invalid event ID (non-numeric) produces a clear error message
--eid accepts a comma-separated list of u32 values
